questions.q: Which group shows a −M effect when attached to a benzene ring?
questions.explain: −CN has a π bond to an electronegative atom and withdraws ring π electrons (−M). −OCH₃, −NHCOCH₃ and −Cl all have a lone pair next to the ring and are +M groups.

questions.q: The N–O bond order in the nitrate ion, NO₃⁻, is:
questions.explain: Bond order = total bonds over all contributors ÷ number of contributors = (2 + 1 + 1) ÷ 3 = 1.33. The value 1.5 applies to nitrite, which has only two contributors.

questions.q: Which statement about writing resonating structures is NOT correct?
options: Only electrons move; nuclei keep their positions
All structures must have the same number of unpaired electrons
No structure may contain a five-bonded carbon
The resonance hybrid is less stable than the most stable contributor
questions.explain: The hybrid is always more stable than any single contributor; the difference in energy is the resonance energy.

questions.q: Consider the nitrobenzyl cations (o-, m-, p-) and the unsubstituted benzyl cation. Which order of stability is correct?
questions.explain: NO₂ destabilises a cation by −M at ortho and para but acts only by −I at meta, so the meta isomer is the least destabilised; all nitro isomers are less stable than benzyl⁺ itself.
